about_the_game:
A long time ago, in a galaxy far, far away there exists a Galactic Empire ruled by Emperor Paipatine the 6969th. The Empire has been warring with rebels for many years, and both sides desperately desire something to boost their spirits from the fighting... And that's where our hero steps in. Squid Inkwell, a tentacalien, is itching for his opportunity to conquer another planet to expand his species's joy-bringing enterprise, and that time has finally come.

Capture the people of Earth using your powers as a tentacalien, putting them to work at your operation in order to pay your dues to the Galactic Empire and take over the planet. Raise the stats of your workers, gather ExP, and make Cheat Items to fortify your operation or you'll find the Empire knocking at the door. Also, don't forget the most important thing... placing the top brass of the world under your feeler!

The Art of Management

Enjoy the thrills of setting up and running a business from stage one.

Gotta Abduct Them All!

There are plenty of people on Earth, each drawn beautifully, to capture and put to work.

Easy Business

While the Empire will always be breathing down your neck for its money, don't worry! It’s always clear what you have to do with the help of in-game hints!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows® 8/8.1/10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core2 Duo or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 9/OpenGL 4.1 capable GPU
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: 1280x768 or better Display. Lag may occur from loading menus or maps. Turn off other programs before running the game.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS *: Windows 11/10/8
  • Processor: 2+ GHz Processor
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL ES 2.0 hardware driver support required for WebGL acceleration. (AMD Catalyst 10.9, nVidia 358.50)
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: 1280x768 or better Display. Lag may occur from loading menus or maps. Turn off other programs before running the game.

short_description: Invade the primitive planet of Earth, setting up a profitable business, abducting its inhabitants, and ultimately conquering the planet.
